headline: Drivers, be careful! From October 1, Italy is restricting Euro 5 diesel vehicles
summary: From October 1, 2026, new restrictions on passenger diesel cars will apply in the Italian regions of Lombardy and Emilia-Romagna. The rules affect Euro 5 diesel vehicles.
why: Vehicle emission restrictions affect car owners, diesel demand and automakers' sales in affected regions. Lombardy and Emilia-Romagna are major northern Italian economic areas.
